scope: Explicit timing fixture only: 8s delay before each of two exact original PNG responses; four unchanged SHA-fenced runtime overlays, all other responses exact base Git. No state injection or changed picture bytes.
originalProof: Both exact original Git blobs were read in bounded memory at preparation and checked against the binding SHA/byte count. HTTP responses still stream those immutable base Git blobs; no media files are copied.
delayPolicy: Before response headers, wait 8 seconds only for either of the two allowlisted original compiled PNG routes. Every request for either route receives that delay. Four stream slots and 64KiB copy remain. Other routes unchanged.
limits: Timing fixture, not measured production latency.
No browser action or app state injection by preparer.
Does not itself prove keyboard behavior or asynchronous Start interruption; actual browser observations and 116-case host proof remain distinct.
